blocks.text: Alkenes ke naam ke IUPAC usool alkanes jaise hain.

items: Sab se lambi musalsal zanjeer jis mein C=C ho parent zanjeer chunein, aur utni hi lambai ke alkane ke naam ka ikhtitam -ane se -ene kar dein.
Zanjeer ko yun number dein ke double bond ke dono carbon atoms shamil hon, double bond ke qareeb sire se shuru karte hue.
Double bond ki jagah double bond ke pehle atom ke number se prefix ke taur par batayein.
Substituent groups ki jagahein un carbon atoms ke numbers se batayein jin se woh jure hain.
Agar parent zanjeer mein ek se zyada double bonds hon to do ke liye alkadienes, teen ke liye alkatrienes, aur yun aage.

blocks.prompt: CH3C(CH3)=CH-CH3 aur CH2=CHCH(CH3)2 ke naam rakhein, aur 3-methylbut-2-ene banayein (Quick Check 11.4b, c).
blocks.explanation: CH3C(CH3)=CHCH3: chaar carbon ki zanjeer C2 par double bond aur C2 par methyl ke saath, 2-methylbut-2-ene. CH2=CHCH(CH3)2: chaar carbon ki zanjeer C1 par double bond aur C3 par methyl ke saath, 3-methylbut-1-ene. 3-Methylbut-2-ene (print mein 3-methyl-2-butene) CH3CH=C(CH3)CH3 hai, jo sab se chhote number ke usool se wahi molecule hai jo 2-methylbut-2-ene.

items: C=C wali sab se lambi zanjeer, -ane se -ene; double bond ke qareeb sire se number; double bond ka pehla carbon locant deta hai; substituents number shuda; do double bonds: -diene, teen: -triene.
